description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament per shitje ne zonen e tregut elektrik, tek Kompleksi 'Grand".
Pozicionohet ne katin e 7 banim, kompleks i ri me ashensor dhe i mirembajtur.
Tipologjia e apartamentit eshte 2+1, me hapesira te bollshme, te organizuara ne nje dhome ndenjeje, kuzhina, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 2 ballkone.
Prona ofron nje mobilim te plote dhe komfort.
Orintimi Jug-Perendim i apartamentit i jep ndricim natyral pergjate dites.
Kompleksi dhe zona perreth ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode.
Per detaje shtese mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment 2+1 for sale near "Mihal Grameno" School
description_en: We offer an apartment for sale in the area of the electrical market, in the "Grand" Complex. It is located on the 7th residential floor, a new complex with an elevator and well maintained. The typology of the apartment is 2+1, with ample spaces, organized in a living room, kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. The property offers complete furniture and comfort. The South-West orientation of the apartment gives natural lighting throughout the day. The complex and the surrounding area offer all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. For additional details, do not hesitate to contact us!
